label: Cast
description: Convert a value to the type of its output: parse text into a number, boolean or JSON, stringify data, or validate an object against a custom type. The output takes the type you declare on it (`-> (value: Signup)`), or, undeclared, the type of the port it feeds. An impossible conversion is a compile error; a value that does not fit fails the node naming the offending field.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The value in the type declared here, or in the type of the port it feeds.
